verdict.rationale: Lambda documents its own S3-compatible adapter, so users can copy files out of their filesystems with standard open tools like rclone and s5cmd. Instances run standard Ubuntu with SSH access, and the service has no long-term commitments, so leaving is practical. However, nothing documents a full account-data export (usage, billing, configuration) or an account-deletion or offboarding process. Missing for 10: documented export of all account data and metadata, an explicit offboarding/deletion path, and independent or hands-on confirmation of complete data egress.
